title: Attach for initiating a PDN connection for emergency bearer services not accepted by the network

entities.name: Attach for emergency bearer services
entities.description: UE procedure for establishing emergency bearer services when initial attach request with emergency PDN connectivity is not accepted by the network.

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used by UE to initiate attach procedure.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST
entities.description: ESM message included in ATTACH REQUEST to request PDN connectivity.

entities.name: Request type
entities.description: Information element in PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST indicating the type of request.

entities.name: Request type set to emergency
entities.description: Condition where PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST has request type set to 'emergency'.

entities.name: Request type set to handover of emergency bearer services
entities.description: Condition where PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST has request type set to 'handover of emergency bearer services'.

entities.name: UE in same selected PLMN
entities.description: Condition where UE is in the same selected PLMN where last attach request was attempted.

entities.name: Inform upper layers of failure
entities.description: UE behavior to inform upper layers about procedure failure, which may trigger CS emergency call or other mechanisms.

entities.name: Attempt EPS attach for emergency bearer services
entities.description: UE behavior to retry attach procedure specifically for emergency bearer services.

entities.name: EMM cause #19 ESM failure
entities.description: Specific EMM cause value that triggers different UE behavior when received.

relations.description: Emergency attach procedure involves sending ATTACH REQUEST message.
ATTACH REQUEST message contains PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message.
PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message contains request type information element.
Request type IE can have value 'emergency' which guards procedure behavior.
Request type IE can have value 'handover of emergency bearer services' which guards procedure behavior.
When UE is in same PLMN, it establishes the behavior to inform upper layers of failure.
When UE is in same PLMN, it establishes the behavior to attempt EPS emergency attach.
Receipt of EMM cause #19 establishes the behavior to attempt EPS attach for emergency services.
